metas.name: All That Breathes
metas.description: Against the darkening backdrop of New Delhi's apocalyptic air and escalating violence, two brothers devote their lives to protecting one casualty of the turbulent times: the bird known as the black kite.

metas.name: Squaring the Circle (The Story of Hipgnosis)
metas.description: In 1968, art students Storm Thorgerson and Aubrey “Po” Powell made a trippy photo collage for their musician friends Syd, David and Roger. The resulting album and album cover, A Saucerful of Secrets, helped launch two careers: that of Pink Floyd, one of the 70s megabands, and of Hipgnosis, which, over the course of the next 25 years, designed a stream of iconic album covers.

metas.name: My Massive Cock
metas.description: An extra-large penis is an object of desire for many. But for some men, extra-large seriously complicates their lives and relationships, and penis reduction surgery seems the only answer.

metas.name: The Look of Silence
metas.description: An Indonesian man with a communist background named Ramli was brutally murdered when the "Communist" purge occurred in 1965. His remaining family members lived in fear and silence until the making of this documentary. Adi, a brother of his, decided to revisit the horrific incident and visited the men who were responsible for the killings and one survivor of the purge. These meetings uncovered sadistic details of the murders and exposed raw emotions and reactions of the killers' family members about what happened in the past - much to Adi's disappointment.

metas.name: Moonage Daydream
metas.description: A cinematic odyssey featuring never-before-seen footage exploring David Bowie's creative and musical journey.

metas.name: Quả Cầu Lửa: Những Vị Khách Từ Vũ Trụ - Fireball: Visitors from Darker Worlds
metas.description: Werner Herzog và Clive Oppenheimer mang đến một hành trình xuyên Trái Đất và vũ trụ để khám phá cách các thiên thạch, sao băng hay những vụ va chạm lớn đánh thức trí tò mò của chúng ta về các thế giới khác và nhìn nhận lại vận mệnh của mình.

metas.name: Marty, cuộc đời ngắn lắm
metas.description: Martin Short nhìn lại cuộc đời ngập tràn niềm vui qua bộ phim tài liệu với những đoạn clip kinh điển, các cuộc phỏng vấn mới và thước phim gia đình chưa công bố có dàn sao góp mặt.

metas.name: It's Never Over, Jeff Buckley
metas.description: Rising musician Jeff Buckley had only released one album when he died suddenly in 1997. Now, never-before-seen footage, exclusive voice messages, and accounts from those closest to him offer a portrait of the captivating singer.

metas.name: The Janes
metas.description: Defying the state legislature that outlawed abortion, the Catholic Church that condemned it, and the Chicago Mob that was profiting from it, the members of “Jane” risked their personal and professional lives to support women with unwanted pregnancies. In the pre-Roe v. Wade era — a time when abortion was a crime in most states and even circulating information about abortion was a felony in Illinois — the Janes provided low-cost and free abortions to an estimated 11,000 women.

metas.name: Will & Harper
metas.description: Khi Harper, bạn tốt của Will Ferrell, công khai mình là người chuyển giới nữ, họ thực hiện chuyến đi phượt để gắn kết và giới thiệu lại với đất nước về con người thật của Harper.

metas.name: Jackass Presents: Bad Grandpa .5
metas.description: Bad Grandpa .5 gives you a whole new perspective on the world of Irving Zisman with bonus scenes and pranks also featuring Spike Jonze as "Gloria" and Catherine Keener as Irving's wife "Ellie", plus a look at the evolution of Johnny Knoxville's naughty alter-ego, the makeup effects, and a behind-the-scenes peek at the idiocy it takes to make a hidden camera movie in public.

metas.name: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
metas.description: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

metas.name: Jodorowsky's Dune
metas.description: Năm 1974, đạo diễn Chile-Pháp Alejandro Jodorowsky đã khởi xướng một dự án táo bạo là chuyển thể tiểu thuyết có ảnh hưởng lớn Dune (1969) của Frank Herbert lên màn ảnh rộng. Sau hai năm và hàng triệu đô la đầu tư, dự án khổng lồ này đã kết thúc trong thất bại; tuy nhiên, các nghệ sĩ mà Jodorowsky tập hợp để thực hiện dự án tiếp tục hợp tác với nhau và cuối cùng đã đặt nền móng cho điện ảnh khoa học viễn tưởng hiện đại.

metas.name: Năm Trái Đất Thay Đổi - The Year Earth Changed
metas.description: Dẫn chuyện bởi David Attenborough, cùng theo dõi những thước phim chưa từng công bố về cuộc sống của nhân loại trong thời kỳ phong tỏa, mở ra cơ hội cho thiên nhiên phục hồi, phát triển. Muôn loài như tìm thấy nhịp sống khi chúng ta sống chậm lại.

metas.name: Đời của Eddie
metas.description: Ở bộ phim tài liệu toàn sao này, Eddie Murphy nhìn lại hành trình phi thường của mình, từ cây hài tuổi teen đi lên huyền thoại Hollywood, với sự hài hước và chân thực trần trụi.

metas.name: My Mom Jayne
metas.description: Through deeply personal interviews with her siblings and an examination of the photographs, letters, and belongings left behind, Mariska assembles a new portrait of her mother Jayne Mansfield, an extraordinary and complex woman.

metas.name: Super/Man: Câu chuyện của Christopher Reeve
metas.description: Sự vươn lên trở thành ngôi sao điện ảnh của Reeve diễn ra sau một tai nạn cưỡi ngựa suýt chết vào năm 1995 khiến anh bị liệt từ cổ trở xuống. Sau vụ tai nạn, anh trở thành nhà hoạt động vì các phương pháp điều trị chấn thương tủy sống và quyền của người khuyết tật.

metas.name: Encanto tại Hollywood Bowl
metas.description: Step into Casa Madrigal for a special concert spectacular as the original voice cast of Disney Animation's Oscar®-winning "Encanto," Stephanie Beatriz, Adassa, Carolina Gaitán, Jessica Darrow, Diane Guerrero, Mauro Castillo, Angie Cepeda and Olga Merediz, along with special guests including Colombian superstar Carlos Vives, reunites for "Encanto at the Hollywood Bowl." This unprecedented concert experience gives you a front-row seat to the musical extravaganza celebrating the global phenomenon.

metas.name: The Social Dilemma
metas.description: Các chuyên gia công nghệ gióng lên hồi chuông cảnh báo về tác động nguy hiểm của mạng xã hội đối với con người.

metas.name: Pumping Iron
metas.description: Amateur and professional bodybuilders prepare for the 1975 Mr. Olympia and Mr. Universe contests as five-time champion Arnold Schwarzenegger defends his Mr. Olympia title against Serge Nubret and the shy young Lou Ferrigno.

metas.name: Jim Henson Idea Man
metas.description: Featuring unprecedented access to Jim Henson's personal archives, filmmaker Ron Howard brings us a fascinating and insightful look at a complex man whose boundless imagination inspired the world.

metas.name: Foka
metas.description: Dr. Dimitri Foka, a Greek doctor from Turkey, survives a Nazi execution in Greece during World War II thanks to his Turkish passport. After graduating, he returns to his hometown, the island of Imroz (Gökçeada), part of Turkey, and becomes the island’s only doctor for many years. Following the Cyprus problem in 1964, state policies targeting the Greek population lead to dispossession, violence, and forced migration on the island, yet Foka refuses to leave.

metas.name: Untold: Caitlyn Jenner
metas.description: Caitlyn Jenner's unlikely path to Olympic glory was inspirational. But her more challenging road to embracing her true self proved even more meaningful.

metas.name: Cuộc Khủng Hoảng Kinh Tế
metas.description: Cuộc khủng hoảng tài chính toàn cầu diễn ra vào mùa Thu năm 2008 đã gây ra hàng triệu người mất việc làm và nhà cửa và đẩy Hoa Kỳ vào một cuộc suy thoái kinh tế sâu sắc. Matt Damon thuật lại một bộ phim tài liệu cung cấp một cuộc kiểm tra chi tiết về các yếu tố dẫn đến sự sụp đổ và xác định những người chơi chính về tài chính và chính trị. Giám đốc Charles Ferguson thực hiện một loạt các cuộc phỏng vấn và theo dõi câu chuyện từ Hoa Kỳ, Trung Quốc đến Iceland đến một số điểm nóng tài chính toàn cầu khác.

metas.name: Defying Gravity: The Curtain Rises on Wicked
metas.description: A behind-the-scenes look at the highly-anticipated film Wicked, featuring interviews with the cast and crew.

metas.name: Back to the Beginning: Ozzy's Final Bow
metas.description: A powerful return to roots, this concert captures Black Sabbath in peak form - reuniting to deliver classic hits with raw energy and legendary precision.

metas.name: Noah Kahan: Trải nghiệm thoát xác
metas.description: Sau khi vụt sáng thành danh toàn cầu, ca sĩ kiêm nhạc sĩ Noah Kahan trở về quê nhà Vermont để tìm lại chính mình trong bộ phim tài liệu chân thực này.

metas.name: Musk
metas.description: An incisive look behind the legend of Elon Musk, the world’s most heralded "inventor-entrepreneur" who has enormous influence on the world in which we all live.

metas.name: Camera Threat
metas.description: Somewhere in the dreary zones of Mumbai's film industry, stuck between star-cult, superstition and the daily gridlock, Camera Threat explores the ambivalent, and sometimes paranoid relationship that this film city has with the moving image itself. Seated on a casting couch, two actors are getting trapped in their impromptu conversations on the unwanted side effects of a world that no longer bothers to tell facts from fiction.  An expanded multi-genre film within the constraints of the so-called Masala Formula popularly known from Indian cinema.

metas.name: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Secret Invasion
metas.description: Through in-depth interviews with cast and crew, and exclusive behind-the-scenes footage, Assembled uncovers how Marvel Studios’ “Secret Invasion” was born. Witness what it took to conjure the world of the show, and spend time with Samuel L. Jackson as he dons the patch once again to engage in the most baffling battle of Nick Fury’s career.

metas.name: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of Deadpool & Wolverine
metas.description: Hugh Jackman, Ryan Reynolds, and director Shawn Levy sit down and spill the proverbial beans about how "Deadpool & Wolverine" was conceived, carried to term, and then birthed.

metas.name: Electric Boogaloo: The Wild, Untold Story of Cannon Films
metas.description: A documentary about the rise and fall of the Cannon Film Group, the legendary independent film company helmed by Israeli cousins Menahem Golan and Yoram Globus.

metas.name: Nǎi Nai & Wài Pó
metas.description: A multigenerational story celebrating director Sean Wang's two grandmothers, one on his father's side and the other on his mother's side.

metas.name: Music by John Williams
metas.description: His unforgettable scores are an essential part of some of the most beloved movies of our time, over a career that spans decades. See and hear maestro John Williams' own story, with insights from filmmakers, musicians, and others he has inspired, complete with rare behind-the-scenes looks at the making of movie history.

metas.name: Câu chuyện khỉ đột: Qua lời kể của David Attenborough
metas.description: Nhà tự nhiên học kỳ cựu David Attenborough kể lại câu chuyện về một đàn khỉ đột đặc biệt, từ lần đầu ông gặp chúng vào thập niên 70 cho đến hiện tại.

metas.name: Hố Đen: Tất Cả Những Gì Chúng Ta Biết
metas.description: Theo chân các nhà khoa học trong hành trình tìm hiểu và ghi lại hình ảnh đầu tiên của lỗ đen trong khi khám phá giới hạn hiểu biết của chúng ta về vũ trụ.

metas.name: Under Fire
metas.description: As a fire captain in Idaho, Rob has spent his life saving others. Now, with the help of an experimental therapy, he may just learn how to save himself.

metas.name: André Is an Idiot
metas.description: André, a brilliant idiot, is dying because he didn’t get a colonoscopy. His sobering diagnosis, complete irreverence, and insatiable curiosity, send him on an unexpected journey learning how to die happily and ridiculously without losing his sense of humor.

metas.name: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
metas.description: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

metas.name: Wings of Life
metas.description: A beautiful love story in danger. Our future depends on an amazing love story between the flowers and fauna consisting of bees, butterflies, birds and bats, which allow these species to reproduce. Delicate and graceful, the flowers are not content to be the ultimate symbol of beauty. On the contrary, their vibrant colors and their exotic flavors are so many wonders that attract pollinators and drunk with desire. All these animals are involved in a complex dance of seduction on which one third of our crops, a dance without which we could survive ... Pollen presents the unsung heroes of the global food chain. Their fantastic worlds are full of stories, drama and beauty. While a fragile and threatened, essential for the balance of the planet, it should now actively protect ...

metas.name: Đầu độc: Sự thật bẩn thỉu về thực phẩm
metas.description: Qua các cuộc phỏng vấn hé lộ thông tin với các chuyên gia và gia đình nạn nhân, bộ phim tài liệu hấp dẫn này xem xét vấn đề về bệnh gây chết người do thực phẩm ở Hoa Kỳ.

metas.name: You Cannot Kill David Arquette
metas.description: Following his infamous championship as part of a marketing stunt for the film Ready to Rumble, David Arquette is widely known as the most hated man in pro-wrestling worldwide. Nearly 20 years after he "won" the initial title, through ups and downs in his career, with his family, and with his struggles with addiction, David Arquette seeks redemption by returning to the ring...for real this time.

metas.name: 11/9: Trong Phòng Tình Huống Của Tổng Thống - 9/11: Inside the President's War Room
metas.description: Khám phá loạt sự kiện xảy ra vào ngày 11 tháng 9 năm 2001 qua góc nhìn của Tổng Thống Bush và các cố vấn thân cận. Qua bộ phim tài liệu này, họ chia sẻ chi tiết về những thời khắc then chốt và các quyết định quan trọng trong ngày lịch sử ấy.

metas.name: Bowling for Columbine
metas.description: This is not a film about gun control. It is a film about the fearful heart and soul of the United States, and the 280 million Americans lucky enough to have the right to a constitutionally protected Uzi. From a look at the Columbine High School security camera tapes to the home of Oscar-winning NRA President Charlton Heston, from a young man who makes homemade napalm with The Anarchist's Cookbook to the murder of a six-year-old girl by another six-year-old. Bowling for Columbine is a journey through the US, through our past, hoping to discover why our pursuit of happiness is so riddled with violence.

metas.name: The History of Concrete
metas.description: After attending a workshop on how to write and sell a Hallmark movie, filmmaker John Wilson tries to use the same formula to sell a documentary about concrete.

metas.name: Marvel Studios Assembled: The Making of She-Hulk: Attorney at Law
metas.description: Join the likes of Tatiana Maslany, Mark Ruffalo, Tim Roth, and Benedict Wong as they reveal how Marvel Studios’ She-Hulk: Attorney at Law was conceived and shaped. Discover what it took for She-Hulk’s creators to pull off the show’s tricky tone and deliver Marvel Studios’ first truly comedic series – one that boldly breaks the fourth wall to acknowledge its own audience, no less!

metas.name: Beware the Slenderman
metas.description: In this horrifyingly modern fairytale lurks an online Boogeyman and two 12-year-old girls who would kill for him. The entrance to the internet quickly leads to its darkest basement. How responsible are our children for what they find there?

metas.name: Chaos: Vụ thảm sát Manson
metas.description: Vào tháng 8 năm 1969, những tín đồ của Charles Manson đã giết bảy người theo lệnh của hắn. Vì sao vậy? Cùng khám phá âm mưu thao túng tâm trí, thử nghiệm của CIA và vụ giết người.

metas.name: Nude
metas.description: NUDE explores perceptions of nudity in art by chronicling the creative process of photographer David Bellemere as he's commissioned by NU Muses founder Steve Shaw to shoot a fine art calendar of nude photographs.

metas.name: The Butch Factor
metas.description: What does mean to be gay and be a man? There's no straight answer for sure. From the Castro culture of the 1970s to today’s Bears and gym rats, this fascinating investigation of gay men and sexuality blows the lid off old stereotypes and showcases a battalion of interviewees including muscle men, rodeo riders, rugby players and cops. The men speak candidly on topics from homophobia to metrosexuality to embracing effeminacy as they reveal what it means to be a gay man in America today.

metas.name: Nữ Hoàng Cờ Vua
metas.description: Trong bộ phim tài liệu này, thiên tài cờ vua Judit Polgár đối mặt với sự hoài nghi, định kiến giới và nhà vô địch Garry Kasparov để khẳng định vị thế giữa những kỳ thủ vĩ đại nhất.

metas.name: Jackass 3D
metas.description: Johnny Knoxville, Bam Margera, Steve-O, Wee Man and the rest of their fearless and foolhardy friends take part in another round of outrageous pranks and stunts. In addition to standing in the path of a charging bull, launching themselves into the air and crashing through various objects, the guys perform in segments such as "Sweatsuit Cocktail," "Beehive Tetherball" and "Lamborghini Tooth Pull."

metas.name: Bản năng làm mẹ
metas.description: Một người phụ nữ bị cảnh sát chặn xe và khai rằng vừa sinh con. Nhưng đứa bé và máu đều không phải của cô ta. Lời dối trá hiểm độc bị phơi bày trong phim tài liệu về tội phạm này.

metas.name: Two Men at War
metas.description: As the war between Russia and Ukraine rages, this George Stephanopoulos documentary pulls back the curtain on the rise of the two men at the center of the conflict – Russian President Vladimir Putin and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy.

metas.name: Jaws @ 50: The Definitive Inside Story
metas.description: The authorized documentary celebrating the film that redefined Hollywood, 50 years after its premiere. Featuring rare archival footage and interviews with acclaimed Hollywood directors alongside Steven Spielberg, top shark scientists, and conservationists, the film uncovers the behind-the-scenes chaos and how the film launched the summer blockbuster, inspired a new wave of filmmakers, and paved the way for shark conservation that continues today.

metas.name: Billie Eilish - Hit Me Hard and Soft: The Tour (Live in 3D)
metas.description: Captured during Billie Eilish's sold-out world tour, a concert experience from one of the most celebrated and successful artists of her generation, presented in immersive 3D.

metas.name: Sự Kỳ Diệu Của Nấm
metas.description: Hãy đi sâu vào thế giới kỳ diệu của các loài nấm, từ nấm làm sạch dầu tràn cho đến mạng lưới nấm ngầm giúp cây cối giao tiếp.

metas.name: X-Rated 2: The Greatest Adult Stars of All Time
metas.description: Documentary sequel that offers a close-up look into the personal lives of the legendary porn stars who've survived the test of time and influenced popular culture. Blends rare interviews with erotic clips and additional appearances by Whoopi Goldberg, Steven Soderbergh and a host of adult stars, directors and trendsetters.

metas.name: Bono: Câu Chuyện Về Sự Buông Bỏ - Bono: Stories of Surrender
metas.description: Qua lời kể, âm nhạc và những trò đùa tinh nghịch, Bono tiết lộ về trải nghiệm cực kỳ riêng tư đã tạo nên người con, người cha, người chồng, nhà hoạt động và trưởng nhóm U2.

metas.name: Trust No One: The Hunt for the Crypto King
metas.description: When the young founder of a collapsing cryptocurrency exchange dies unexpectedly, irate investors suspect there's more to his death than meets the eye.

metas.name: Groundswell
metas.description: Viewers travel around the world, getting a global perspective on the three biggest (and interrelated) problems our species faces – climate change, species loss and soil loss. More importantly, viewers will learn about the multitude of methods in which regeneration is addressing and even reversing these trends on an ecosystem-by-ecosystem basis, all while storing enough carbon in the ground to help mitigate our changing climate.

metas.name: Trái Đất: Một Ngày Tuyệt Vời
metas.description: Trái Đất: Một Ngày Tuyệt Vời : một hành trình đáng kinh ngạc tiết lộ sức mạnh tuyệt vời của thế giới tự nhiên. Trong suốt một ngày, chúng tôi theo dõi mặt trời từ những ngọn núi cao nhất đến những hòn đảo xa xôi nhất đến những khu rừng kỳ lạ. Đột phá trong công nghệ làm phim mang bạn đến gần với một loạt các nhân vật khó quên. Nói với sự hài hước, gần gũi và cảm giác lộng lẫy về vẻ huy hoàng điện ảnh, Trái đất: Một ngày tuyệt vời làm nổi bật mỗi ngày đầy những điều kỳ diệu hơn bạn có thể tưởng tượng cho đến bây giờ.

metas.name: Free Leonard Peltier
metas.description: Leonard Peltier, one of the surviving leaders of the American Indian Movement, has been in prison for 50 years following a contentious conviction. A new generation of Native activists is committed to winning his freedom before he dies.

metas.name: La Esperanza
metas.description: Narrated by Javi, the only family member able to cross the border, Hope revisits his parents' migration story and the difficult reality that keeps them from returning home.

metas.name: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
metas.description: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

metas.name: Đóng dấu từ đầu
metas.description: Với hoạt họa sáng tạo và hiểu biết sâu sắc từ chuyên gia, bộ phim tài liệu dựa trên cuốn sách ăn khách của Ibram X. Kendi khám phá lịch sử của các ý niệm phân biệt chủng tộc ở Mỹ.

metas.name: Istintobrass
metas.description: One of the most controversial, original and loved figures of Italian cinema. The most censored director of all time. An anarchist of the film, a gifted experimenter, an inventor of dreams. A truly great artist.

metas.name: Hãy Nhìn Tôi Dưới Ánh Sáng Đẹp Nhất - Come See Me in the Good Light
metas.description: Trong câu chuyện đầy cảm xúc và niềm vui về tình yêu giữa mất mát, hai nhà thơ nổi tiếng Andrea Gibson và Megan Falley tìm thấy sức mạnh và cả niềm vui bất ngờ trong năm có thể là năm cuối cùng họ được bên nhau.

metas.name: Capitalism: A Love Story
metas.description: Michael Moore comes home to the issue he's been examining throughout his career: the disastrous impact of corporate dominance on the everyday lives of Americans (and by default, the rest of the world).

metas.name: Corman's World
metas.description: A chronicle of the long career of American filmmaker Roger Corman, the most tenacious and ingenious low-budget producer and director in the US film industry, a pioneer of independent filmmaking and discoverer of new talent.

metas.name: Who Is Martin Mull?
metas.description: Discover Martin Mull's restless reinvention from smoky folk clubs to primetime sitcoms to gallery walls, told in his own words and by the friends who watched it happen, including Steve Martin, Tom Waits, David Alan Grier and others.

metas.name: Crystal Lake Memories: The Complete History of Friday the 13th
metas.description: Taking inspiration from Peter M. Bracke's definitive book of the same name, this seven-hour documentary dives into the making of all twelve Friday the 13th films, with all-new interviews from the cast and the crew.

metas.name: Sunday Best: Chuyện chưa kể của Ed Sullivan
metas.description: Ed Sullivan phá vỡ rào cản khi mời nghệ sĩ da đen đến chương trình tạp kỹ tối Chủ Nhật. Phim tài liệu này tôn vinh di sản thúc đẩy bình đẳng của người tiên phong ngành truyền hình.

metas.name: Everybody’s Everything
metas.description: The story of artist Lil Peep from his birth in Long Island and meteoric rise as a genre blending pop star & style icon, to his death due to an accidental opioid overdose in Arizona at just 21 years of age.

metas.name: Michael Jackson: Đó Là Anh
metas.description: A compilation of interviews, rehearsals and backstage footage of Michael Jackson as he prepared for his series of sold-out shows in London.

metas.name: The Lion King at the Hollywood Bowl
metas.description: In honor of “The Lion King's” 30th Anniversary, the Hollywood Bowl transforms into the Pride Lands for an immersive concert event. This music event celebrates the franchise's evolution, from the 1994 animated film to the Tony Award-winning musical, and the 2019 and 2024 live-action films, honoring the music and characters that made it a global phenomenon.

metas.name: Melania
metas.description: Offering unprecedented access to the 20 days leading up to the 2025 Presidential Inauguration — through the eyes of the First Lady-elect herself — step inside Melania Trump's world as she orchestrates inauguration plans, navigates the complexities of the White House transition, and reenters public life with her family. With exclusive footage capturing critical meetings, private conversations, and never-before-seen environments, Mrs. Trump returns to one of the world's most powerful roles.

metas.name: Voyage of Time: Life's Journey
metas.description: A celebration of the universe, displaying the whole of time, from its start to its final collapse. This film examines all that occurred to prepare the world that stands before us now: science and spirit, birth and death, the grand cosmos and the minute life systems of our planet.

metas.name: JFK Revisited: Through the Looking Glass
metas.description: Thirty years after the release of his film JFK (1991), filmmaker Oliver Stone reviews recently declassified evidence related to the assassination of President John F. Kennedy, which took place in Dallas on November 22, 1963.

metas.name: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
metas.description: With unprecedented access to the official archives and intimate recollections from the band, both current and past,  Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition invites fans to experience one of the most iconic journeys in music history.  Spanning five decades, this electrifying documentary charts the band’s rise from the pubs of East London to the world’s biggest stadiums. Featuring exclusive interviews with band members and contributors such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich and Chuck D, as well as all-new animated sequences of the band's legendary mascot, Eddie, the film offers a rare and intimate look at Iron Maiden’s uncompromising vision and unwavering connection with their truly global army of fans.

metas.name: Be Brave
metas.description: A documentary film that chronicles the extraordinary personal and entrepreneurial journey of Renzo Rosso, one of the most visionary figures in international fashion and communication. It tells this story by engaging with and utilizing artificial intelligence in a provocative and original way, placing the debate over the boundaries between human creativity and technology—and between the real and the artificial—at the heart of the film.

metas.name: 9to5: Days in Porn
metas.description: 9to5 - Days in Porn focuses on the people behind a controversial and multi-billion dollar industry "The Adult Entertainment industry". It depicts their stories, each one different, unadorned and authentic, without glorification or prejudice. It delivers deep insight into their personal lives - from glamorous to grotesque - strange, fascinating, offensive, absurd and sometimes funny moments all at once.

metas.name: Love, Lizzo
metas.description: Follow pop star Lizzo and explore her humble beginnings to her meteoric rise with an intimate look into the moments that shaped her hard-earned rise to fame, success, love and international stardom.

metas.name: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
metas.description: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

metas.name: Sea Lions of the Galapagos
metas.description: Follow Leo, a handsome sea lion pup who's learning how to navigate life alongside his mother, Luna.

metas.name: Before America
metas.description: Before America is a cinematic documentary uncovering the Indigenous histories of Michigan long before the United States existed. From the 1763 uprising at Fort Michilimackinac to Odawa trail trees and the overlooked women of Fort Detroit, the film reveals how Anishinaabe nations shaped Great Lakes history and helped spark the chain of events that ultimately pushed the American colonies.

metas.name: Daniel
metas.description: The remarkable first-person story of filmmaker Daniel Northcott, who documented his travels around the world, including a visit to a mysterious Mayan cave that may have precipitated his death.

metas.name: Willow: Behind the Magic
metas.description: Featuring the breakout stars from the series and returning legends, this documentary takes viewers behind the scenes for an in-depth look at the making of the hit original series.

metas.name: Entangled
metas.description: Efforts to protect North Atlantic right whales from extinction, the impacts of those efforts on the lobster industry, and how the National Marine Fisheries Service has struggled to balance the vying interests.  There are now believed to be fewer than 400 right whales, making them among the planet’s most endangered species. Between millions of lobster lines and warming waters due to climate change, their population has been plummeting, and their survival is threatened. The federal government is proposing regulations which could reduce lobster lines by half in much of the Gulf of Maine and harm the livelihoods of many lobstermen and has sparked a political backlash. The future of the iconic species hangs in the balance.

metas.name: Diabolical: The Epstein Files
metas.description: It's the scandal that has shocked Americans and rocked the Trump administration. A legal and political saga that has shattered fundamental beliefs that all are equal in the eyes of the law. What do the Epstein Files reveal?

metas.name: Darwin's Nightmare
metas.description: Africa in the sixties. The Nile perch, a ravenous predator, is introduced into Lake Victoria as a scientific experiment, causing the extinction of many native species. Its meat is exported everywhere in exchange for weapons, creating a globalized evil alliance on the lake shores. An infernal nightmare in the real world that wipes out Darwin's Theory of Evolution.

metas.name: Armed Only with a Camera: The Life and Death of Brent Renaud
metas.description: On March 13, 2022, filmmaker Brent Renaud was killed by Russian soldiers, the first American journalist to die while reporting on the war in Ukraine. His younger brother and collaborator, Craig Renaud, recovered Brent’s body and his final recordings from Ukraine and brought them back to their childhood home in Arkansas. As Brent’s journey to his final resting place unfolds, the film chronicles the years he and his brother spent covering some of the world’s most dangerous conflicts.

metas.name: Senna
metas.description: Bộ phim tài liệu tiết tấu nhanh kể về Ayrton Senna, một trong những tay đua cừ khôi nhất trong lịch sử giải Công thức Một và cũng là một người hùng tại quê hương Brazil.

metas.name: Che đậy
metas.description: Ông đã cống hiến cả sự nghiệp để vạch trần những câu chuyện mà giới quyền lực muốn chôn vùi. Từ Mỹ Lai đến Abu Ghraib, hãy khám phá sự nghiệp cả đời của phóng viên Seymour Hersh.

metas.name: Đắm Tàu: Ác Mộng Trên Biển
metas.description: Qua những thước phim chưa từng công bố và lời kể của những người sống sót, bộ phim tài liệu sống động này tái hiện vụ đắm tàu du lịch hạng sang năm 2012 và thảm họa xảy ra sau đó.

metas.name: Sharks Up Close with Bertie Gregory
metas.description: Bertie heads to South Africa for his most audacious mission yet. The wild waters here are a hotspot for one of the ocean’s most famous and feared predators, the great white shark. Diving in the shallows without a cage, Bertie will attempt to film these huge sharks. By entering their domain, he discovers the challenges they face on our rapidly changing planet.

metas.name: The Skywalker Legacy
metas.description: The story lives forever in this feature-length documentary that charts the making of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker.

metas.name: Being Elmo: A Puppeteer's Journey
metas.description: Beloved by children of all ages around the world, Elmo is an international icon. Few people know his creator, Kevin Clash, who dreamed of working with his idol, master puppeteer Jim Henson. Displaying his creativity and talent at a young age, Kevin ultimately found a home on Sesame Street. Narrated by Whoopi Goldberg, this documentary includes rare archival footage, interviews with Frank Oz, Rosie O’Donnell, Cheryl Henson, Joan Ganz Cooney and others and offers a behind-the-scenes look at Sesame Street and the Jim Henson Workshop.

metas.name: Spider-Man: All Roads Lead to No Way Home
metas.description: JB Smoove and Martin Starr host a celebration of 20 years of "Spider-Man" movies, from the Sam Raimi trilogy to Marc Webb's movies and the trio from Jon Watts.

metas.name: Untold: The Death & Life of Lamar Odom
metas.description: This documentary traces the life of Lamar Odom, from his rise to NBA fame and marriage to Khloé Kardashian to his near-fatal overdose in a Nevada brothel.
